content:
# AO-shaped skill catalog entry (session overlay → client.spoken_output).
id: spoken_output
description: Assist TTS voice style — plain speech, short answers, no markdown.
capabilities: Spoken-output constraints for Home Assistant Assist TTS via HACS Comstar.
good_for: voice turns, greeter, voice responder
planner_hint: Attach for any HACS Comstar spoken reply path.
user_goal_keywords:
  - voice
  - speak
  - assist
  - tts

content:
  body: |
    Spoken-output rules (mandatory):
    - Reply in English only (US/UK Latin script). Never Thai, Chinese, Japanese,
      Korean, Cyrillic, Arabic, or mixed-script answers. If you drift, rewrite
      the whole reply in English before responding.
    - Plain conversational sentences only.
    - No markdown, no bullet lists, no numbered lists.
    - No URLs, no code blocks, no special formatting.
    - Target about 40 words unless the user explicitly asks for detail.
    - Do not mention that you are an AI unless asked.
    - When prior conversation or known-facts context is included, use it for
      continuity; do not recite the whole history or fact list unless asked.

inject:
  target: backstory
  heading: "## HACS Comstar spoken output"
  max_chars: 2000
